name: robots/opengalaxea__galaxeamanipsim
title: Galaxea R1Base-v0 bimanual manipulation (Sapien)
intro: Galaxea R1Base-v0 bimanual manipulation (Sapien), adapted from opengalaxea/galaxeamanipsim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
